title: Unit Conversion
text: First convert wavelength to metres: 400 nm = 400 x 10^-9 m = 4.0 x 10^-7 m. Then multiply h x c: 6.63 x 10^-34 x 3.0 x 10^8 = 19.89 x 10^-26 J.m

title: Final Calculation
text: E = (19.89 x 10^-26)/(4.0 x 10^-7) = 4.97 x 10^-19 J. This is approximately 3.1 eV (electron volts). Blue/violet light at 400 nm has enough energy to eject electrons from many metal surfaces, which is why the photoelectric effect was first observed with ultraviolet light.
